areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Direct link to objectives, components and indicators on investment management and results contracts, but no resources allocated and not a central objective, so impact is low.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Debt restructuring is the core of the project, with all resources, verifiable indicators, viable targets and a financing-advantage study, giving high impact.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: No link between general objective and pension protection; payroll audit is not pension protection; no resources allocated to related components; indicator does not demonstrate it.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Climate governance product exists, but the budget-marker indicator only tracks budgeting and does not measure capacity gains; no relevant indicators or targets, no resources.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Targeting investment inside the state reduces intra-state, not regional, inequality; no indicator or target for the area and no allocated resources.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: No specific objective, component or resources tied to the area; a budget-marker indicator is relevant but impact cannot be measured.
